shape: C-wrap (long west-around corridor + east dead-end pocket, N+E gates)
description: C-shaped wrap-around corridor. The north portal enters at top-center; the east portal sits in the SE area. To get between them you walk a long counterclockwise wrap: down through center, west across, north up the west wall, east across the south wall, then to the east portal. A short east-side dead-end pocket branches off the north entry zone (rx1d3q / 4i52v5 / guxif9 / cbxvqm) — likely a combat or objective bay.

portals.north: spawn_north at (1.13, -23.41) — gate on the north (low-Z) side, center X
portals.east: spawn_east at (10.66, 19.22) — gate on the east side of the south arm

anchors.description: center pivot — branches into the east pocket and the long west wrap (matches 4i52v5)
west arm south end, just west of center (matches m8a9qc)
west arm SW corner / further along (matches o711um)
west arm north corner — bend back east along the south (matches re9ym3)
south arm east-center, joins east_gate (matches hms0ec)

traversalNotes: Direct N→E: spawn_north → north_inner → center → west_arm_s → west_arm_w → west_arm_n → sw_corner → south_arm_w → south_arm_e → spawn_east. NINE hops — the room wraps counterclockwise around an interior void.

EAST POCKET (east_pocket_n + east_pocket_e + center) is a dead-end side area branching off north_inner / center. Reach via center → east_pocket_n → east_pocket_e → reverse. The pocket is NOT a shortcut to east_gate — there's no walkable link from east_pocket_e to the south arm.

SOUTH-ARM CLIQUE: south_arm_w, south_arm_e, south_arm_c, south_arm_sb form a small clique covering the south arm where east_gate lives. Objectives in the south arm route via south_arm_w or south_arm_e.
STRICT-BACKBONE on the west wrap (west_arm_s → west_arm_w → west_arm_n → sw_corner): single-file corridor segments. Don't emit cross-wrap shortcuts.
Stages are never physically rotated — all positions are stage-local mesh-space XZ.
